verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the square. The quote is small, the 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' attribution and the 'SOLSTICE' label are illegible at this size, the logo is tiny, and the oversized circle and can crowd the bottom-right while the left side stays empty. B rearranges for the banner: the quote mark sits beside a larger, readable three-line quote, and the attribution can be read. Its flaws are that the logo is blown up out of proportion and floats in the middle-left with no alignment to anything, and the can is shrunk inside a small circle so its label can't be read, which leaves the bottom half loosely balanced.
